title: Remember the small repairs
brief: I manage a small rental and forget recurring maintenance until a tenant complains.

target_population.role: solo landlord maintaining one four-unit rental building
target_population.coverage_limit: single property; no tenant logins or contractor marketplace

core_task.summary: complete an overdue task and confirm its next recurrence is scheduled
core_task.success_oracle: marking the overdue gutter clearing done removes it from the overdue lane and shows its next occurrence scheduled 180 days later

not_applicable_states.loading: the nine recurring tasks are seeded local records and rescheduling is date arithmetic, so nothing asynchronous ever leaves the dashboard waiting

state_recipes.empty: mark all three seeded overdue tasks done; the overdue lane collapses to its all-clear message
state_recipes.validation-error: submit the new-task form with a blank name or a recurrence of zero days; an inline error appears on the field
state_recipes.success: mark the gutter clearing done; a confirmation shows the 2027-02-08 next-due chip
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the first overdue card's done button shows its focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the dashboard at 390x844; lanes stack vertically with overdue first

acceptance_facts: The seed defines nine recurring tasks across four flats and exactly three are overdue on 2026-08-12.
Completing the gutter clearing schedules its next occurrence 180 days later on 2027-02-08.
The overdue lane orders work by days overdue with the oldest item first.

product_signature.mechanism: overdue lane that converts each completion into the next scheduled occurrence automatically
product_signature.anchor: left overdue lane of the dashboard
product_signature.brief_trace: forget recurring maintenance until a tenant complains
product_signature.counterfactual: a plain one-shot todo list would fit a moving-day checklist brief, not recurring building upkeep
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows the gutter card leaving the overdue lane wearing its 2027-02-08 next-due chip

anti_goals: no tenant portal, messaging, or complaint intake
no contractor booking or cost marketplace
no photo upload or document storage

content_seed.data_notes: nine seeded tasks total; gutter clearing, boiler service, and smoke alarm test are the three overdue on the frozen date 2026-08-12
